analyticalQuestion: Can signed projected-Lamb work stay positive for arbitrarily many viscous times, what happens at fixed positive relative levels, and does critical residence alone close an unweighted bottom trace?

evidenceClasses.reducedChain: fixed-step complex RK4 on the exact 2D3C sideband chain
evidenceClasses.weakCoupling: analytic coefficient limits as mu tends to zero
evidenceClasses.asymptoticGuide: 0.5 times mu inverse is illustrative only

supportedClaim: Sign-only residence has no universal finite viscous-time constant on the exact global-smooth family; fixed positive relative levels remain critical there; critical residence alone does not imply unweighted trace summability.
claimBoundary: Reduced-chain checks, exact weak-coupling limits, and an abstract functional construction only; no DNS, no 3D PDE time stepping, no general occupation theorem, no singularity, no regularity theorem, no originality claim, and no Millennium-problem claim.
